note: Hand-eye calibration routine of this scene (the same routine in every scene). Starting from the start pose after the grader's 0.5 s settle, the hand executed the waypoints in 'routine' (sorter plan format, 25 Hz, through World.step_waypoint, exactly as a plan) WITH this scene's hidden calibration error. At each entry of 'captures' (after the wrist had held the commanded pose for 1.2 s) both cameras took one RGB-D image pair: <k>_<cam>_rgb.png / <k>_<cam>_depth.png. Same cameras (cameras.json), conventions and noise model as the start images. Only the table and the hand are drawn (the cube and the pieces are left out); the hand is drawn with the public Wuji render meshes (render/*.glb of the hand asset, glTF y-up converted to z-up, at each link's pose). The hand touched nothing during the routine.
